summary: 28 publish, 12 publish_flagged, 0 reject. All 41 live sources were fetched with the required counsel user agent and all 66 evidence quotes were checked programmatically against saved pages; PDF raw reading order was required for two multi-column case-study quotes. The three new examples exactly match the fetched official notebooks' code cells, their harness differences match substitution.diff, and their sim_check statuses remain not_run; examples/results.json separately reports all three passed. Worst problems in the earlier use cases remain: ten customer studies assign SDKs their article bodies do not name; three Pasqal stories and the Quantinuum BMW release do not support the assigned program model; the Quantinuum TKET support is navigation chrome; one Pasqal aspiration was mislabelled as an outcome; the platinum paper names BMW only as an author affiliation, not a customer; and most source dates are copyright years, Git commit/update metadata, or article:modified_time rather than printed publication dates. One differential-equation tutorial is corrected from physics_simulation to machine_learning. Customer city coordinates remain approximations and are flagged where linked. Rejected ids: none.
